Head_and_Face: Head is clean-cut with a broad skull and long, square muzzle.
Ears are moderately long, set high, and hang close to the head.
Eyes are medium-sized, brown, with an intelligent, eager expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is athletic and well-muscled with a slightly sloping topline and deep chest.
Coat is short, dense, fine and sleek in solid liver or liver-and-white combinations.
Coat has a distinctive ticking or roan pattern in patched varieties.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is docked and carried horizontally.
Built for endurance and speed with webbed feet for swimming.
Characteristic pointing stance with one front paw raised and body frozen in alert position.

Head_and_Face: Head is noble and refined with a broad skull and long, square muzzle.
Ears are thin, pendant, and set moderately low.
Eyes are medium-sized, brown, harmonizing with coat color.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is lean, muscular, and well-proportioned with a slightly arched loin and deep chest.
Coat is rich, deep red (rust-golden), smooth, dense, and close-lying.
Coat color ranges from golden rust to dark russet red with no other markings.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is docked to approximately one-quarter length and carried level.
Elegant, athletic build resembling the Weimaraner but with distinctly red coat.

Head_and_Face: Head is long and lean with a flat skull and well-defined stop.
Ears are low-set, pendant, and covered with long, silky hair.
Eyes are medium-sized, oval, and dark brown with a soft, gentle expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is elegant and well-proportioned with a slightly sloping topline and deep chest.
Coat is long, silky, flat, predominantly white with colored markings (blue belton, orange belton, tricolor, or lemon belton).
Coat features distinctive feathering on ears, chest, belly, legs, and tail.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is medium-length, straight or slightly curved, with long flag-like feathering.
Gait is smooth, effortless, and ground-covering.

Head_and_Face: Head is long and lean with a slightly domed skull and long, square muzzle.
Ears are set back, low, pendant, and covered with long, silky hair.
Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark hazel to brown with a keen, intelligent expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is elegant, well-balanced, and athletic with a slightly sloping topline.
Coat is chestnut-brown to mahogany-red, long, silky, and flat-lying.
Coat is moderate in length on the body with abundant feathering on ears, chest, back of legs, and tail.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is carried level with the back, moderately long, and well-feathered with a flag-like appearance.

Head_and_Face: Head is clean-cut with a broad skull and square muzzle.
Ears are low-set, pendant, and covered with long hair.
Eyes are medium-sized, dark brown, and oval with an alert, intelligent expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is substantial and well-muscled with a level topline and deep chest.
Coat is soft and glossy with black-and-tan coloration.
Tan markings appear above eyes, on sides of muzzle, chest, legs, and under tail.
Moderate feathering on ears, chest, belly, back of legs, and tail.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is short, thick at the base, and carried level or slightly below.

Head_and_Face: Head is clean-cut with a round skull and medium-length muzzle.
Ears are moderately long, pendant, and set high.
Eyes are medium-sized, amber to dark brown, with an alert, intelligent expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is well-balanced and athletic with a short-coupled frame and deep chest.
Coat is smooth, dense, moderately long in orange-and-white or liver-and-white patterns.
Coat has minimal feathering compared to other spaniels.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is naturally short or docked, carried high.
Tall, leggy build for a spaniel giving a more pointer-like appearance.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad and square with a pronounced occiput and deep flews.
Ears are large, grape-leaf shaped, and set at eye level.
Eyes are dark amber, medium-sized, and deep-set with a solemn expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is long, low, and substantial with a massive head and heavy bone structure.
Coat is long, silky, predominantly white with lemon or orange markings.
Coat is abundant, straight, and weather-resistant with feathering on chest, legs, and belly.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is docked, carried level, and well-feathered.
Low-slung, heavy build with a solemn, dignified expression.

Head_and_Face: Head is clean-cut with a medium-length muzzle and moderate stop.
Ears are long, broad, lobular, and set at eye level.
Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and hazel to dark brown with a gentle, pleading expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is compact, well-proportioned, and slightly longer than tall with a level topline.
Coat is medium-length in black-and-white or liver-and-white patterns.
Coat is flat or slightly wavy with abundant feathering on chest, legs, belly, and ears.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is docked and carried level, well-feathered.
Gait is smooth and effortless with good reach and drive.

Head_and_Face: Head is clean-cut with a slightly domed skull and medium-length muzzle.
Ears are pendant, lobular, and set at eye level, smaller than the English springer.
Eyes are medium-sized, brown, and almond-shaped with a gentle expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is compact, well-balanced, and slightly longer than tall.
Coat is silky, straight, and weather-resistant in distinctive rich red-and-white.
Coat has moderate feathering on chest, legs, and belly.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is docked and carried level with moderate feathering.

Head_and_Face: Head is well-proportioned with a rounded skull and square muzzle.
Ears are long, lobular, set low, and heavily feathered.
Eyes are large, round, and dark brown with a soft, pleading expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is sturdy and well-balanced with a slightly sloping topline.
Coat is long, wavy, silky in various solid colors (black, red, golden, liver) or parti-color patterns.
Coat is abundant with heavy feathering on chest, legs, belly, and ears.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is docked and carried level with moderate feathering.
Merry tail action is a distinctive feature.
